data.name: Emberwild
data.detailed_description:
LIVE IN THE WORLD OF EMBERWILD

"You dive deep into the wilderness, wanting to start a new life with the woman who has been your companion for as long as you can remember. Suddenly, your wife is kidnapped right infront of your very eyes."

You thought you were living the perfect life, picking berries and hunting animals for food, collecting water from streams and rivers, crafting a home and furniture, building tools to make your life easier or crafting weapons incase you'd ever need to use them. It turns out, you were too late.

The only thing left is her diary. Fragments of her life and the only memory you have of her.

EXPLORE THE WORLD AND FIND THE ANSWERS.

"You explore the wilderness for answers, unfolding the truth behind your wife's disappearance. You uncover hidden, forbidden knowledge, incomprehensible, dark and powerful forces. The forest opens up its true nature to you."

After your sudden awakening, you discover a book left behind by your wife. You have no recollection of this book ever having entered your life. You know it belongs to her because you recognise her writing, but it's all jumbled up. What was she doing with this book? 

Monstrous creatures rise from the dark, ancient mysteries reveal themselves as you cross marshy lands, climb perilous cliff paths,explore underground dungeons and follow the clues she left behind.

SURVIVE BY ANY MEANS, AT ANY PRICE.

"Your mind will be racing. Who took her? What took her? What do I do? What should I do? Progress through the world and find the answers to your burning questions. You'll be exploring treacherous forest, boggy marches, misty hills, dark dungeons, dangerous caves and much more. This isn't a simple walk in the park, this is learning to survive what you cannot see."

Surviving in the world of Emberwild is more than picking a few fruits and chopping down trees, it's learning to survive what comes in the day as well as the night. You must keep your hunger and thirst satisfied, all whilst trying to make sure your supplies don't run dry.

data.short_description: A dark fantasy survival adventure game set in the lands of the Emberwild. After your wife is taken by dark, mysterious forces, you explore the dangerous wilderness, uncovering unknowable secrets, and surviving ancient powers now hunting you for trespassing into their domain.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Runs at 1080p on Low/Medium settings
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

content_descriptors.notes: Acts of violence and blood will be shown due to the nature of the game.
